project.name: GTT Market Timing Strategy — Core Library Integration
project.description: Optional, opt-in Growth Trend Timing (GTT) market-timing overlay for the finance backtest library. Monitors UNRATE (UE_12M) and VIX (VIX_5D) recession-risk signals, gated by a 200-day SMA price-trend filter, and moves VTI + VTI_LEAPS capital into a configurable defensive allocation when defensive. LEAPS are closed (realizing gains/tax) on defensive entry and reopened as fresh 2-year contracts on re-entry.
project.overview: GTT integrates into run_backtest as an optional overlay. Signal computation and FRED/yfinance I/O live in a new pure-core-plus-I/O-edge module src/finance/gtt.py. A GttSignalData frozen dataclass carries a pre-computed, lag-adjusted daily position_mask (1=Long, 0=Defensive) directly consumable by run_backtest. When defensive and price < SMA200, VTI shares are sold and LEAPS contracts closed; proceeds ride a fixed-weight defensive sleeve (R_f cash + KMLM/VGIT/GLD), and on re-entry the parked capital rebuys shares and fresh DITM 2-year LEAPS at prevailing spot/IV. LEAPS lifecycle requires a segmented simulation that runs run_leaps_simulation per Long window seeded with parked capital and force-closes at each Long->Defensive boundary. Backtests with gtt_config=None are byte-for-byte unchanged.

data_schemas.name: GttConfig
data_schemas.description: Frozen configuration for the GTT overlay. Lives in portfolio.py. Opt-in via PortfolioConfig.gtt_config. Extensible for future per-ticker signals (e.g. VXUS).

fields.name: vix_p90_threshold
fields.description: Fixed VIX P90 threshold as a decimal (e.g. 0.272 == 27.2%). Caller computes from desired history to avoid look-ahead; library applies no look-ahead protection.

fields.name: sma_window
fields.description: Rolling window (trading days) for the equity price SMA trend filter. Default 200 (GTT_SMA_WINDOW).

fields.name: vix_consecutive_days
fields.description: N consecutive days VIX >= threshold required to fire VIX_5D. Default 5 (GTT_VIX_CONSECUTIVE_DAYS).

fields.name: unrate_pub_lag_days
fields.description: Calendar days after the reference date at which the UNRATE print becomes actionable (1st Friday of following month + following Monday ~= 4). Default 4 (GTT_UNRATE_PUB_LAG_DAYS).

fields.name: defensive_weights
fields.description: Weights the defensive sleeve holds when defensive. Must sum to 1.0 (abs tol 1e-6). Sentinel key 'R_f' means T-bill cash earning risk_free_rate/252 daily. Non-R_f keys must exist in target_weights. Default {'R_f':0.25,'KMLM':0.25,'VGIT':0.25,'GLD':0.25}.

data_schemas.name: GttSignalData
data_schemas.description: Frozen container for pre-computed, lag-adjusted GTT signals. Lives in gtt.py. position_mask is directly consumable by run_backtest.

fields.name: position_mask
fields.description: DatetimeIndex -> int, 1=Long / 0=Defensive. Already 1-day lag-adjusted (signal at close t -> position at open t+1).

fields.name: ue_signal
fields.description: DatetimeIndex -> int, 1=UE_12M active (UNRATE >= trailing 12M MA, pub-lag shifted).

fields.name: vix_signal
fields.description: DatetimeIndex -> int, 1=VIX_5D active (VIX >= threshold for N consecutive days).

fields.name: unrate_start
fields.description: Earliest date in the UNRATE series used.

fields.name: vix_start
fields.description: Earliest date in the VIX series used.

data_schemas.name: LeapsGttCloseEvent
data_schemas.description: Frozen record of a forced full LEAPS close triggered by a GTT defensive signal. Lives in leverage.py. Distinct from a roll (no replacement opened) and a partial close (this is a full close and is taxed).

fields.name: close_date
fields.description: Execution date of the forced close (last Long day before a Defensive window).

fields.name: tax_paid
fields.description: max(0, gain_realized) * ltcg_rate; 0.0 if TAX_SHELTERED or loss.

fields.name: net_proceeds
fields.description: mtm_value - tax_paid, parked in the defensive sleeve.

data_schemas.name: LeapsLedger (extended)
data_schemas.description: Existing LeapsLedger gains one field to record GTT-driven forced closes. Backward compatible (defaults to empty tuple).

fields.name: gtt_close_events
fields.description: All GTT-driven forced-close events across all segments. Defaults to () so existing non-GTT ledgers are unchanged.

data_schemas.name: PortfolioConfig (extended)
data_schemas.description: Existing PortfolioConfig gains one optional field to opt into GTT. None preserves existing behavior exactly.

fields.name: gtt_config
fields.description: None = GTT disabled (existing behavior unchanged). When set, __post_init__ validates that non-R_f keys in defensive_weights exist in target_weights.

api_contracts.name: compute_ue_signal
api_contracts.description: Pure. Return a daily int Series (0/1): 1 where UNRATE >= trailing 12-month moving average, shifted forward by the publication lag. Monthly UNRATE is resampled to daily via forward-fill.

inputs.name: rolling_window_months
inputs.description: Trailing MA window in months. Default 12.

inputs.name: pub_lag_days
inputs.description: Calendar days to shift the actionable signal forward. Default GTT_UNRATE_PUB_LAG_DAYS (4).

raises: ValueError: if unrate is empty or has fewer than rolling_window_months observations

api_contracts.name: compute_vix_signal
api_contracts.description: Pure. Return a daily int Series (0/1): 1 where VIX >= threshold for exactly N consecutive days (rolling window of daily >= flags summing to N).

inputs.name: vix
inputs.description: Daily VIX series as a decimal (e.g. 0.20), DatetimeIndex.

inputs.name: consecutive_days
inputs.description: Number of consecutive days at/above threshold to fire. Default GTT_VIX_CONSECUTIVE_DAYS (5).

outputs.name: return
outputs.description: Daily 0/1 series; DatetimeIndex aligned to vix.

api_contracts.name: compute_position_mask
api_contracts.description: Pure. Combine ue_signal OR vix_signal with the 200d SMA price-trend filter, then apply a 1-day lag. Returns 1 (Long) when no recession risk, or recession risk but price >= SMA; 0 (Defensive) when recession risk and price < SMA. During SMA warm-up (NaN SMA) treat as above-SMA (stay Long).

inputs.name: equity_prices
inputs.description: Daily equity (VTI) price series for the SMA filter.

inputs.name: sma_window
inputs.description: SMA window in trading days. Default GTT_SMA_WINDOW (200).

raises: ValueError: if input series indexes cannot be aligned

api_contracts.name: fetch_gtt_signal_data
api_contracts.description: I/O boundary. Fetch UNRATE from FRED and VIX from yfinance, compute all signals via the pure functions, apply publication lags, and return a lag-adjusted GttSignalData. Marked '# pragma: no cover'.

inputs.name: vix_p90_threshold
inputs.description: Fixed P90 threshold decimal supplied by caller.

inputs.name: equity_prices
inputs.description: VTI price series for the SMA; if None, fetched internally via yfinance.

raises: ValueError: if UNRATE or VIX fetch returns empty / FRED API is unreachable

api_contracts.name: close_leaps_contract
api_contracts.description: Pure. Mark a LEAPS contract to market and fully close it (no replacement opened). Computes realized gain, LTCG tax on positive gains (0 if TAX_SHELTERED or loss), and net proceeds. Mirrors roll_contract minus the reopen.

inputs.name: iv
inputs.description: Implied volatility for Black-Scholes pricing at close.

inputs.name: ltcg_rate
inputs.description: Combined LTCG+NIIT rate applied to positive gains.

inputs.name: rfr
inputs.description: Continuously compounded risk-free rate for BS pricing.

outputs.name: return
outputs.description: Full close record with mtm_value, gain_realized, tax_paid, net_proceeds.

api_contracts.name: run_segmented_leaps_simulation
api_contracts.description: Pure. Walk the timeline as alternating Long/Defensive windows defined by position_mask. Per Long window, call run_leaps_simulation seeded with initial_capital = parked pool, then force-close every live contract on the window's final day. Through Defensive windows, compound the parked pool by defensive_gross_return and add diverted LEAPS contributions. Assemble a combined LeapsLedger including gtt_close_events.

inputs.name: defensive_gross_return
inputs.description: Daily gross return of the defensive sleeve (defensive_weights . asset_returns, R_f -> rfr/252).

inputs.name: config
inputs.description: LEAPS config (iv, ltcg_rate, account_type, rfr, dividend_yield).

inputs.name: risk_free_series
inputs.description: Optional daily annualized rfr series for BS pricing.

inputs.name: iv_series
inputs.description: Optional daily VIX series; config.iv is the floor.

inputs.name: initial_capital
inputs.description: Carved-out starting LEAPS capital deployed on the first Long day. Default 0.0.

outputs.name: return
outputs.description: Combined ledger across all segments with contracts, roll_events, partial_close_events, and gtt_close_events populated.

raises: ValueError: if price_series and position_mask indexes cannot be aligned

api_contracts.name: run_backtest (GTT branch)
api_contracts.description: Deterministic (no I/O). Adds an optional gtt_signal parameter. Pre-computes GTT-governed tickers, reindexes position_mask, computes the defensive-sleeve gross return, and (if LEAPS present) builds the segmented ledger. In the daily loop, on defensive days base-equity holdings ride the defensive sleeve and LEAPS MTM is naturally 0 (no live contracts). Rebalance runs first (Option C) then GTT override is applied. Monthly LEAPS/VTI contribution shares divert to the defensive sleeve when defensive. gtt_signal=None preserves existing behavior exactly.

inputs.name: gtt_signal
inputs.description: Pre-computed GTT signal. None = GTT disabled. Default None.

outputs.name: return
outputs.description: Unchanged shape. weight_history shows 0 VTI weight and non-zero defensive weights during GTT-defensive periods.

raises: ValueError: if gtt_signal provided but config.gtt_config is None (or vice versa)
ValueError: if a defensive_weights ticker is absent from return_data

features.name: run_segmented_leaps_simulation (pure)
features.description: Segment the timeline by position_mask into Long/Defensive windows. Per Long window run run_leaps_simulation seeded with the parked pool as initial_capital, then force-close all live contracts on the window's last day. Compound the parked pool through Defensive windows via defensive_gross_return and add diverted contributions. Assemble a combined LeapsLedger with gtt_close_events.

performance_requirements.notes: Single chronological pass; each date processed once across all segments. Per-window run_leaps_simulation is itself linear; windows partition the timeline.

test_requirements.description: All-Long equivalence to run_leaps_simulation.

features.name: Directional validation of the multi-asset GTT portfolio
features.description: analyses/gtt_library_validation.py runs the full multi-asset GTT backtest (LEAPS overlay + the 4-asset {R_f,KMLM,VGIT,GLD} defensive sleeve) and asserts directional, risk-reduction behavior vs. an equivalent GTT-off buy-and-hold portfolio. The EDA (outputs/gtt_findings.md, Table 5.1) was a 100%-equity long/cash simplification and is used ONLY as a qualitative reference, not a numeric reproduction target. The goal of the library is a multi-asset portfolio, so the defensive sleeve materially changes the numbers by design.

performance_requirements.notes: One backtest pass plus metric computation.

property_based_testing.rationale_if_disabled: Project uses pytest only; no hypothesis. One-off analytical script.

mutation_testing.rationale_if_disabled: Project uses pytest only; no mutmut. Also a one-off analytical/validation script exempt from coverage gates per project policy.

acceptance_criteria: GTT-on max drawdown is strictly less severe (closer to zero) than the GTT-off buy-and-hold portfolio over the 1993-2026 window.
GTT-on Sharpe (and Sortino) is >= the GTT-off buy-and-hold portfolio; any metric that regresses is printed as a FAIL row.

During each of the 2001, 2008 employment-driven recession windows, GTT-on realized return exceeds GTT-off (the sign of the excess is positive), consistent with the EDA's qualitative finding that the signal earns its keep in those episodes.
The script exits non-zero if any tracked directional assertion fails.

test_requirements.description: Marked slow; run the multi-asset GTT-on vs GTT-off backtests on live data and assert the directional risk-reduction bands (drawdown, Sharpe/Sortino, recession-window excess).

edge_cases: Defensive sleeve (KMLM/VGIT/GLD) can gain during a defensive window, so multi-asset CAGR may EXCEED the EDA's all-cash reference — this is expected, not a failure.
2022 rate-driven bear is a known weak spot (UE blind, VIX late); the directional recession-window assertion is scoped to employment-driven recessions (2001, 2008), not 2022.
Use total-return series where available; document any residual price-vs-total-return gap as a known deviation.
features.clarification_notes: Resolved: the EDA was a simplification; the library target is a multi-asset portfolio. Validation is directional (risk reduction vs. buy-and-hold using the real LEAPS + 4-asset defensive config), not a numeric reproduction of Table 5.1.

risks.description: GTT signal fires before the 200d SMA is computable (first sma_window days), so no trend gate exists.
risks.mitigation: During SMA warm-up (NaN SMA) treat price as above-SMA and stay Long. Covered by F-05 warm-up acceptance criterion and edge-case test.

risks.description: UNRATE gap or FRED/yfinance outage could silently produce an all-Long mask, masking recession risk.
risks.mitigation: fetch_gtt_signal_data raises ValueError on empty/failed fetch and never defaults to no-recession. Covered by F-07 acceptance criteria.

risks.description: position_mask index may not align with returns.index due to holiday/exchange calendar mismatches.
risks.mitigation: Reindex position_mask to returns.index with ffill inside run_backtest; document max acceptable gap. Covered by F-10 edge case.

risks.description: Rapid Long/Defensive flips churn LEAPS, incurring close tax plus fresh premium each cycle, dragging returns.
risks.mitigation: Real economic cost, not a bug: surfaced via gtt_close_events count and realized tax so it is measurable. VIX_5D's 5-consecutive-day rule damps flip frequency. Covered by F-09 whipsaw edge case.

risks.description: Caller may pass a full-sample VIX P90, introducing look-ahead bias into the backtest.
risks.mitigation: Documented explicitly in GttConfig as the caller's responsibility; library applies no look-ahead protection by design. Threshold is stored on GttSignalData for reproducibility.

risks.description: Backtests starting before 1993 have no VIX data; GTT would be undefined.
risks.mitigation: fetch_gtt_signal_data raises ValueError if start_date < 1993-01-01. Covered by F-07 acceptance criterion.

risks.description: A forced GTT close taxes gains at ltcg_rate even for contracts held < 366 days, understating tax vs. true short-term capital gains rates.
risks.mitigation: Documented simplification (assumption A4a). ltcg_rate is applied uniformly; a future enhancement can distinguish STCG. Realized tax is recorded per event for auditability.

risks.description: Changes to run_backtest could inadvertently alter behavior when gtt_config/gtt_signal are None, breaking every existing backtest.
risks.mitigation: F-10 acceptance criterion requires exact equality to the pre-change BacktestResult on the existing test corpus when gtt_signal=None; enforced as a regression gate before merge.

risks.description: The EDA (Table 5.1) is a 100%-equity long/cash simplification. Treating it as a numeric reproduction target for the multi-asset library (LEAPS + 4-asset defensive sleeve) would falsely flag the by-design differences (e.g. defensive sleeve gains lifting CAGR above the all-cash reference) as regressions.
risks.mitigation: F-11 validates DIRECTIONALLY (drawdown reduction, Sharpe/Sortino improvement, positive recession-window excess in 2001/2008) against a GTT-off buy-and-hold run of the SAME multi-asset config — not against EDA numbers. The EDA is documented as a qualitative reference only.

implementation_phases.name: Constants & Config
implementation_phases.description: Low-risk additive changes: GTT constants in consts.py, GttConfig dataclass, and the optional gtt_config field on PortfolioConfig with validation. No behavior change when unused.

implementation_phases.name: Pure Signal Functions
implementation_phases.description: Create src/finance/gtt.py with pure, testable signal functions (UE, VIX, position mask) and the GttSignalData container. Unit + Hypothesis property tests, no I/O.

implementation_phases.name: I/O Boundary
implementation_phases.description: Implement fetch_gtt_signal_data (FRED + yfinance), delegating computation to the pure functions. Marked '# pragma: no cover'; mocked unit tests plus optional slow live integration test.

implementation_phases.name: Segmented LEAPS Simulation
implementation_phases.description: Add LeapsGttCloseEvent + LeapsLedger.gtt_close_events, the pure close_leaps_contract helper, and run_segmented_leaps_simulation implementing close-and-reopen with fresh contracts across Long/Defensive windows.

implementation_phases.name: run_backtest GTT Branch
implementation_phases.description: Wire the GTT overlay into run_backtest: pre-compute governed tickers/mask/defensive return and segmented ledger; apply the defensive override (rebalance-first, Option C) and contribution diversion. Preserve the gtt_signal=None path exactly.

implementation_phases.name: Multi-Asset Directional Validation
implementation_phases.description: analyses/gtt_library_validation.py runs the full multi-asset GTT portfolio (LEAPS + 4-asset defensive sleeve) and asserts directional risk-reduction behavior vs. a GTT-off buy-and-hold run of the same config. The EDA is a qualitative reference only, not a numeric reproduction target.
